rows.note: Use this colloquial word for a car or vehicle engine.

example.english: The engine in my car broke down.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 go3 gai2 waai6 zo2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term, especially for a technical or software engine and in more formal contexts.

example.english: This search engine is very fast.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sau2 cam4 jan5 king4 hou2 faai3
